title: Kona Token Trade
summary: Backend services for a blockchain-based token-trading platform at Kona Software Lab. I owned 6 of its 30 Spring Boot microservices and moved inter-service calls onto Kafka so one unavailable service could no longer fail a trade.

title: Card Personalization System
summary: Brought Kona I's smart-card personalization system from its head office in South Korea to Bangladesh: studied the specifications, learned the running system, set it up in the Bangladesh office, and personalized cards end to end.

title: LoadLens
summary: A student workload planner that checks whether a week of classes, deadlines, and commitments actually fits. Language models propose schedule changes; deterministic code checks every one before it applies.
